verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a laptop processor, not a data application, so getting AI insights from your data inside the product does not apply to it. The evidence shows only developer building blocks (Ryzen AI Software, the Lemonade SDK, the GAIA agent framework, ONNX Runtime) for building such features, plus an AI Analyzer for model compilation and inference rather than user data. None of this means the chip itself ships the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
